stop_rule: Run controls once. Do not start grounding replay if any control mismatches or errors. No selective retries or retuning. Stop new calls at 52 calls or 2400 seconds.
development_acceptance: All four controls match, at least five of six known answerable cases complete and supported, both unanswerable cases refuse, no unsupported displayed claim or attribution error in source review. Passing is development evidence only.
limits: Known inspected r3 questions and saved passages; no retrieval/database operation, no baseline rerun, no new reserved validation, primary-agent AI source review.
